Hi Alex / Priya 

Thanks again for the call today  great to learn more about Acme's plan for integrating a summarization + Q&A flow into the internal knowledge base. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we're all aligned: 

1) Goal for the eval
- Primary success criteria: 95% accuracy on the top-5 answers for the provided prompt set and <= 300ms 95th percentile token latency on typical queries.
- Secondary: cost-per-1k-tokens target to be discussed during kickoff.

2) Proposed trial plan (2 weeks)
- Week 0: kickoff (aligned success criteria, access to prompt set and test data, assign API keys)
- Week 1: run evals + collect metrics; Redwoods SE will iterate on batching and quantization suggestions
- Week 2: joint review, recommend model/quantization profile, handoff to pilot integration

3) Data & access
- Please share a representative prompt set (10-20 queries) and a sample doc bundle. We prefer S3 or Drive link.

4) Who should attend kickoff
- From Acme: Product lead (you or Priya), one engineering lead
- From Redwood: myself + Marissa (customer success) + Connor (solutions engineer)

I've attached a short eval proposal and a draft SOW for your procurement team to review. Can you confirm availability for a 60-min kickoff next week? Our availability (PST):
- Wed 11/11 10:00-11:30
- Wed 11/11 14:00-16:00
- Thu 11/12 09:00-11:00

If none of those work, propose 2 slots and we'll adapt.

Thanks  looking forward to the kickoff.
